Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos entre os melhores empregadores do mundo, pela revista Forbes, e como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar, pela GPTW. O Grupo Pierre Fabre é, antes de tudo, uma aventura humana. Cada colaborador partilha os mesmos valores, humanistas e autênticos, são esses: ABRAÇAR A CAUSA do Grupo, aplicando e reforçando sua estratégia. Buscar por sua melhor PERFORMANCE. title: Engenheiro Civil - Geotécnico
description: Sobre a empresa: Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso. Liderança. Confiança. Expertise. Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação. Sobre a vaga Dimensionamento e detalhamento de projetos de estruturas de contenção, aterros sobre solos moles, estabilidade de taludes de solos e rochosos, fundações e estruturas enterradas, instrumentação, rebaixamento de lençol freático; Programação, acompanhamento, controle de medição e interpretação de investigações geológico-geotécnicas; Realização de visitas técnicas para a coleta de dados e acompanhamento da execução dos projetos. Requisitos: Formação: Graduação de Engenharia Civil com especialização em Geotecnia. Desejável mestrado na área de Geotecnia. Conhecimentos: Conhecimento em AutoCAD CIVIL 3D, Revit, Slope/W (GeoStudio), Slide ou equivalente e Pacote Office. Conhecimento em modelagem por elementos finitos e experiência com projeto na área de infraestrutura serão diferenciais. Experiência: Projetos geotécnicos na área de estruturas de contenções, estabilidade de taludes, tratamento de aterros sobre solos moles e fundações. Desejável experiência em BIM. Modalidade Presencial - Botafogo. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description: Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil. De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100). Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova. Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço. É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão. Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos: O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente. Atribuições O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar. 2-Técnico de Necropsia O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente. Atribuições O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil. As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais. As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias. Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos. O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso. Atribuições Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso. 5-Delegado de Polícia O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres: Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública; Assegurar a observância da lei; Defender as instituições públicas; Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais; Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais; Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital. Etapas do concurso A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital. O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social. Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo de Auxiliar de Necropsia da Polícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já para Técnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59. O Inspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38. A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95. Detalhes do concurso Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ) Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior #J-18808-Ljbffr

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. description: O Grupo Seres, em parceria com empresa Industria de Plásticos, seleciona profissional para atuar na função de Gerente de Manutenção Atividades: O Gerente de Manutenção na Indústria PET é o profissional responsável por planejar, gerenciar as atividades de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva dos equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Seu papel é garantir que todas as máquinas e sistemas estejam operando de forma eficiente e segura, contribuindo para a continuidade e a qualidade do processo produtivo. Principais Responsabilidades 1. Gestão da Equipe de Manutenção Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de manutenção, definindo funções, delegando atividades e garantindo que todos os membros da equipe desempenhem suas funções de forma eficiente. Monitorar o desempenho da equipe, realizar avaliações periódicas de desempenho e aplicar feedbacks para garantir a melhoria contínua do trabalho. 2. Planejamento e Execução de Manutenção Planejar e implementar o cronograma de manutenção preventiva e corretiva para todos os equipamentos da planta, minimizando paradas não programadas e otimizando a disponibilidade dos ativos. Garantir a execução eficaz das atividades de manutenção, como lubrificação, inspeção, ajustes e substituição de peças de equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Trabalhar junto ao setor de compras para garantir a aquisição de peças e materiais de qualidade, dentro dos prazos e com o melhor custo-benefício. Controlar os custos de manutenção, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros disponíveis, otimizando os gastos com peças, serviços e mão de obra. 4. Melhoria Contínua e Eficiência Operacional Gerir e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção, como o tempo médio entre falhas (MTBF) e o tempo médio para reparo (MTTR), e propor melhorias nos processos. Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos de manutenção, utilizando ferramentas de gestão, como o PM (Planejamento de Manutenção) e o TPM (Manutenção Produtiva Total). Colaborar com outras áreas da produção para entender as necessidades específicas de cada linha e otimizar o uso dos equipamentos. 5. Gestão de Projetos e Inovações Tecnológicas Coordenar projetos de melhorias ou expansão de instalações, equipamentos e sistemas, implementando novas tecnologias ou modernizações nos processos de manutenção. Acompanhar a instalação de novos equipamentos e garantir que os processos de manutenção sejam adequados desde a fase de implantação. Implementar tecnologias de manutenção preditiva, como monitoramento remoto de equipamentos e análise de dados para identificar falhas antes que ocorram. 6. Segurança no Trabalho e Conformidade Regulatória Garantir que todos os procedimentos de manutenção sigam rigorosamente as normas de segurança do trabalho e as regulamentações ambientais aplicáveis. Promover a cultura de segurança, realizando treinamentos sobre o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e procedimentos de segurança. Realizar inspeções regulares nas instalações para garantir que todos os sistemas e equipamentos estejam operando dentro dos parâmetros de segurança e conformidade regulatória. 7. Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios Analisar relatórios de desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, fornecendo feedback para a equipe de manutenção e a gestão da fábrica. Preparar relatórios periódicos sobre o desempenho da manutenção, incluindo indicadores como custos, tempo de inatividade, e eficiência dos serviços prestados. Apresentar relatórios para a diretoria e outras áreas da empresa, propondo ações para resolver problemas de manutenção e melhorar a performance da planta. 8. Gestão de Contratos e Fornecedores Gerenciar contratos de serviços terceirizados relacionados à manutenção, como fornecedores de peças, consultorias ou serviços especializados. Negociar prazos, custos e condições com fornecedores, garantindo a qualidade e a entrega pontual dos serviços e materiais necessários para a manutenção da planta. Avaliar a performance dos fornecedores, garantindo que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela empresa. Profundo conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, além de experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (como CMMS). Conhecimento em gestão de equipes, controle de custos e planejamento de manutenção. Familiaridade com as normas de segurança industrial, regulamentações ambientais e boas práticas de manutenção. Noções de controle de estoque e gestão de fornecedores. Habilidades Liderança e gestão de equipes, com foco em desenvolvimento, motivação e resultados. Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisões rápidas em situações de emergência. Habilidade em gestão de projetos, com foco na melhoria contínua dos processos. Excelente comunicação, tanto para reportar resultados para a direção quanto para interagir com as equipes de produção e outros departamentos. Habilidade para trabalhar com indicadores de desempenho e ferramentas de análise de dados. Características Pessoais Proatividade e visão estratégica, com foco em otimizar processos e reduzir custos. Forte senso de organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas atividades simultaneamente. Comprometimento com a segurança e qualidade em todas as etapas da manutenção. Espírito de liderança e habilidade para motivar a equipe a alcançar as metas estabelecidas. title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Compensation Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Offshore Marine Group A Transocean está focada em ser o empregador favorito para a indústria de perfuração. Resumo do Perfil do Cargo VAGA EXCLUSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA. Job Profile Summary Exclusive For People With Disabilities. Carry out cargo handling duties, general cleaning, maintenance and other manual labor as assigned/directed. About Transocean Reconhecemos que nosso pessoal é essencial para nos ajudar a atingir nossa visão, por isso promovemos uma cultura que incentiva, apoia e celebra a diversidade de todos os tipos. Ela alimenta nossa inovação e nos conecta mais perto de nossos clientes e das comunidades em que operamos. We recognize that our people are key to helping us achieve our vision, so we have fostered a culture that encourages, supports and celebrates diversity of all kinds. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we operate in. Equal Opportunity Statement Qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Descrição do Cargo Reporting Reports to: Crane Operator Supervision None Pre‑Requisite/Qualification Secondary School / Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable) Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S. Norway Specific: Must hold qualifications in accordance with relevant authority requirements, the requirements of the Havtil ref. Activities Regulations. Minimum participation in education as per NOG024 for Operator level. General Requirements Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel. Demonstrates care for the safety and well‑being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit. Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings. Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements. Complete company training requirements for the Roustabout job level as per the training matrix, including local/regulatory requirements. If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed. Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill. Operational Discipline Requirements Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process. This means, doing the right thing, the right way, every time following Transocean 5 Key Expectations of Task Planning and Risk Assessment. Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting. Understanding the hazards associated with the task. Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards. Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures. Recognize at‑risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned. Participate in After Action Reviews to provide lessons learned from performing the task. HSE Requirements Protect personnel, the environment, and assets by eliminating hazards and reducing health and safety risks. Understand Company OI & HSE requirements applicable to the job position. Execute work in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements. Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at‑risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed. Use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work. Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations to a supervisor. Incorporate the Control of Work process into all work, whether working alone or as part of a team. Understand and implement major accident barriers / controls applicable to the job position. Maintain a safe and organized work area throughout and on completion of all work. Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill. Participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required. DUTIES The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Roustabout, the Supervisor and the Roustabout will apply the Control of Work process to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed. General Duties A Roustabout works under the supervision of the Crane Operator, but when deemed necessary they may be temporarily assigned to other department supervisors including Drilling, Maintenance, Engineering, Marine and Subsea. During this time, they will be supervised by the appropriate line supervisor for the task and expected to carry out duties in accordance with Company policies. Duties Are Varied But May Include Housekeeping, cleaning, tidying and correct disposal of trash. Surface preparation and painting. Assisting in preventative and corrective maintenance of rig equipment. Manually move equipment, tools and materials around the installation, using manual lifting aids and working ‘Hands Free’ whenever physically possible. Norway Specific: Ensure that all lifting equipment is in accordance with NORSOK R‑003. Must have knowledge of enterprise of competence and necessary documentation as described in statutory requirements, NORSOK R‑003 and rig specific procedures. Lifting Operations – About A significant portion of a Roustabout's work involves cargo handling operations. There are significant hazards associated with this work which must be conducted in accordance with Company and Industry Rigging and Slinging Standards including: Inspection of cargo for potential dropped objects. Inspection of lifting slings and shackles. Inspection of cargo containers and contents to verify adequate securing. Storage of lifting and rigging equipment correctly when not in use. Identify, report and dispose of damaged lifting equipment. Using Hands‑Free Tools to control the load. Knowledge and awareness of hazards associated with proximity to danger and suspended loads. Understanding and complying with the requirements for safe step‑back areas. When deemed competent, act as banksman for crane operations, utilizing the company approved hand signals or use of radios following correct communication protocol. When deemed competent, operate air hoists, chain hoists and other lifting devices. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Country Lead, Brazil
description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones. Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations. MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact. Samba may collect personal information directly from you, as a job applicant, and may also receive personal information from third parties, for example, in connection with a background, employment or reference check, in accordance with applicable law. For further details, please see Samba\'s Applicant Privacy Policy. For residents of the EU, Samba Inc. is the data controller. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. title: Rigless Operations Foreman- Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description: Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia. Overview We are seeking a Rigless Operations Foreman to join Unconventional Resources Completion Operations Division under the Completion Operations Department URCOD. The UR Completion Operation Division is responsible for executing required Rigless operations in unconventional fields. The support includes supervising rigless sites with up to 200 service contractors to execute a variety of rigless operations including multistage hydraulic fracture, coiled tubing operations, well testing operations, while maintaining safety and compliance in accordance with industry standards and company policies. Your primary role is to lead and supervise all rigless well intervention operations (wireline, slickline, coiled tubing and snubbing) including but not limited to plug and perf frac operations, post- frac wellbore coiled tubing cleanout, through tubing fishing and milling operations, in addition to maintaining compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards, enforcing safe work practices and conducting on job safety meetings. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Interface directly with engineers, service company personnel, and management to ensure alignment on operational objectives and risk mitigation. Conduct site inspections, job observations, and equipment audits to ensure equipment and personnel are operating within required standards. Ensure well barrier integrity and adherence to well control requirements during all intervention activities. Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned initiatives to drive continuous improvement. Contribute to the growth and capability of junior team members. Qualifications Technical Diploma or Bachelor's degree in relevant fields, such as petroleum technology or mechanical engineering from a recognized and approved program. 10-15 years’ experience in rigless well intervention operations that includes planning and execution of stimulation, wireline, slickline, coiled tubing and flowback operation in critical sour gas and preferably unconventional operational environment. Experience in unconventional resources or HPHT, tight gas & oil well with a very good understanding of well intervention and stimulation operation and its impact on well completion. Proven record in running all types intervention operations required in unconventional wells: Coiled tubing, Wireline, slick line, Hydraulic fracturing, flow back operations. Familiar with wellhead and downhole completion design, optimization, and troubleshooting. Extensive knowledge of industry regulations, safety practices and standards related to surface and downhole equipment selection. Experience in optimization of surface well intervention operation using latest new technologies and best practices. Able to complete an investigation when issues occur and finalize root cause analysis. Experience in performance optimization, cost control, and operational efficiency improvements in unconventional well environments. Strong expertise in unconventional wells operation, well performance analysis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Consultor de Negócios (Ekotruck)
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Consultor de Negócios (Ekotruck) abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Sua missão: Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais a frotistas e transportadoras, oficinas. Analisar a performance de peças e serviços (pós-venda) na operação do cliente. Elaborar propostas comerciais venda de peças novas, seminovas e para planos de manutenção. Identificar gargalos operacionais no cliente e sugerir soluções Ekotruck (Reman/Desmonte/Locação). Conhecimento em ferramentas de vendas e pacote Office. Perfil analítico para entender as necessidades técnicas do cliente. Conduzir negociações consultivas, apresentando soluções que agreguem valor ao cliente. Requisitos: Superior em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Logística ou áreas correlatas. Experiência com vendas consultivas, atendimento comercial externo ou pós‑venda. Conhecimento no segmento de transportes, caminhões, peças ou serviços automotivos será um diferencial. Habilidade em negociação, comunicação e relacionamento com clientes. Conhecimento em pacote Office e ferramentas de vendas/CRM. Capacidade analítica para identificar necessidades e oportunidades no cliente. Disponibilidade para visitas externas e viagens. description: Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. Deep knowledge of the Rio de Janeiro corporate landscape and an active local network among finance leaders, CFOs, and key corporate decision-makers. Adaptability to fast-changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate independently. Nice to haves Experience selling complex SaaS, financial technology, ERP systems, or corporate card solutions. Who we are We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup . Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. What we offer Competitive salary and stock options ( ESOP ) from day one Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese , Spanish, and English (our corporate language) Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results At Clara, we’ll support your growth. If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. title: Brand Ambassador / Activation Manager, L43 - Rio, Brazil
description: The Activation Manager role represents a strategic transformation in how Zamora Company approaches the market. Moving beyond traditional brand advocacy, this position serves as a strategic partner to both On-Trade and Off-Trade channels, with a clear focus on driving sell-out, ensuring flawless execution of our brands across all touchpoints, and delivering measurable return on investment in the Rio region. With a strong entrepreneurial mindset, this individual will spend the majority of their time in-market, working hands‑on to elevate execution. They will lead the adoption of the AVQPAP model (Availability, Visibility, Quality, Price, Activation, Promotion) to bring the Picture of Success to life. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. This role is critical to advancing Zamora's ambition of building a best‑in‑class route-to-market and execution model in Brazil. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Field Execution & Market Presence Be present in the market on a daily basis, visiting On Trade, Off Trade and Key Accounts, ensuring the correct execution of Zamora’s brands. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Monitor and master the AVQPAP execution standards (Availability, Visibility, Quality of Display, Price, Activation, Promotion) across the territory. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Support sales reps during visits, helping them to sell, place, activate and upgrade Zamora brands. Train distributor and customers’ sales forces on ZC Brands (brand building and story‑selling) Trade Marketing & Activation Design and execute point‑of‑sale activation plans tailored to Rio’s On & Off Trade reality. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Activation, Sales or Brand Ambassador roles, ideally in the alcoholic beverages industry. Having worked with distributors is a plus Deep understanding of On-Trade and Off-Trade dynamics in Rio, with a strong “in‑market” mindset and passion for being close to the consumer (bars, restaurants, clubs, and retail). Good understanding of On Trade & Off Trade dynamics in Rio. Strong ability to execute and drive others to execute. Proven ability to execute with excellence and influence others to deliver against high standards in the field. Strong relationship‑building skills, with the ability to engage and partner effectively with distributor sales teams, bartenders, and retail customers. Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Naturally curious and connected to cultural trends (music, nightlife, gastronomy, fashion), with the ability to anticipate emerging opportunities in the market. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. This role is a key pillar in Zamora’s ambition to build a best‑in‑class execution model in Brazil—ensuring our brands are visible, desired, and flawlessly brought to life at every relevant point of sale in Rio. Zamora Company is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Driller - Brazil
description: The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. The Driller will be conversant with all statutory requirements relating to Well Control and Well Intervention, with all personnel directly or indirectly involved with well operations conforming to the instructions issued by them. Duties & Responsibilities Coordinate, when needed, the Deck Supervisor on his supervision of the deck crew and 3rd Party/vendors on deck Liaise with the Tool Pusher and On Shift Client Representative regarding any changes to the approved well program and communicate these requested changes to all personnel working under their supervision. As delegate of the Rig Superintendent/ Tool Pusher, secure the well in emergency situations and always be aware of environmental aspects. Ensure that the Tool Pusher, Rig Superintendent and Client are advised of all current and/or changing conditions. Under instruction from the Tool Pusher they will conduct Emergency Disconnection Drill to ensure that all personnel are familiar with these operations and record the results in the Operations Daily report. First line is responsible for carrying out the well control and EDS procedures in situations of need emergency disconnect. Under instruction from the Tool pusher usher and or Rig Superintendent they will conduct Well Control Drills. Ensure that well control equipment is correctly maintained, installed and pressure tested. Take direction from the Tool Pusher in all Well Control Operations. Ensure that they have full understanding of the vessel's Well Control Philosophy that includes the current HdB Policies on Well Control & Barriers. Request written dispensation from the tool pusher for any operations that cannot be carried out under the Helix Well Control & Barrier Policies. Conduct Pre-shift, TBT’s, TOFS, Daily drills, & weekly safety meetings with their crew. Ensure that Helix Health & Safety policies are communicated to and understood by all crew members. Ensure that all Supervisors communicate through toolbox meetings, all operational safety aspects of the 12-hour shift. In conjunction with the Tool pusher ensure vessel Well Operations Personnel are being trained to meet the company’s training matrix requirements. Ensure that the appropriate logs and records are maintained throughout their shift. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet daily to discuss previous 24 hours and ongoing operations. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet as and when situations dictate, they are required. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix and Client safety & PPE policies by all personnel working on deck. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix & Statutory Lifting procedures and requirements by all personnel under his supervision. Record all relevant operational information (including but not limited to tool string and subsea equipment data, dimensions, hanging weights, overpulls etc.). They will ensure that this data is readily available in the doghouse throughout the project as required and officially recorded in their daily operational log. Be competent to operate the MPT and associated MPT systems. Directly supervise & record the opening and closing of the Intervention System and Subsea Tree. Ensure, on an ongoing basis, that all parties under their supervision have clear and effective lines of communication as required, and will ensure that operations do not commence until this is in place and confirmed. Ensure that operations are carried out in accordance with the latest instruction issued by the OMT with reference to the project documentation where required, and that all personnel under their supervision are clear as regards their role in the forward operation. Complete appraisal for all members of their crew & ensure that it is given to the Tool Pusher or Rig superintendent prior to their departure at the end of each trip. Instigate weekly DROPS inspections, ensuring actions are corrected, reported & logged in the DROPS register. Assist the vessel Maintenance team & Chief Engineer to maintain vessel equipment. Review and as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and JSAs. Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities Tool Pusher for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes. Perform, if required, the same duties as the Assistant Driller. QHSE Following and complying with all the company's health, safety and environment policies, objectives/targets and procedures Minimum Qualifications Requirements High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum 3 experience effectively working as a Driller or equivalent in well intervention projects. Qualification As per Helix training and competence directives. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: R&T Project Lead Subsurface
description: Employer company TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda Context & Environment Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TotalEnergies e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo. Respeitar orçamentos e cronogramas, garantindo a eficiência de custos, bem como auditar e analisar eventuais desvios ou não conformidades. Representar a filial perante parceiros externos e organizações empresariais, sempre em alinhamento e respeitando os valores e a estratégia da TTE. Como Líder de Projetos de Subsuperfície de Pesquisa e Tecnologia, o(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, considerando a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, por meio da contribuição para a melhoria da eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia. Responsabilidades Coordenar e direcionar programas de P&D relacionados a tecnologias selecionadas pela sede da TotalEnergies e pela TEPBR para apoiar as necessidades de Exploração & Produção. Essas tecnologias abrangem todos os domínios de Geociências — Geofísica, Geologia e Reservatórios — tanto para Óleo & Gás quanto para aplicações de Transição Energética, principalmente reservatórios para armazenamento de CO₂; Atuar como ponto focal técnico da afiliada para temas de geociências relacionados a CCS, assegurando a integração entre as disciplinas de Geologia, Geofísica e Reservatórios; Revisar, desafiar e validar os principais entregáveis técnicos relacionados a estudos e projetos pilotos de CCS, além de oferecer expertise e suporte às equipes de ativos, garantindo robustez e consistência dos estudos de subsuperfície em CCS; Assegurar interação eficaz com a rede global de P&D da TotalEnergies, incluindo participação em atividades de avaliação e qualificação, mantendo forte alinhamento com as equipes e programas OneTech P&D / TL / SRTP; Liderar programas de P&D em Geociências para CCS: identificar, propor e dirigir projetos de P&D voltados a desafios de subsuperfície em CCS, além de gerenciar sua execução, assegurando qualidade técnica, relevância, alinhamento com as prioridades do negócio e transferência eficaz dos resultados para as equipes operacionais. Manter forte interação com OneTech P&D, Houston CDR e parceiros de pesquisa, garantindo alinhamento com os programas globais de tecnologia; Atuar em interface com SGI, Ativos e Parceiros, em estreita coordenação com Geologia, Geofísica e Reservatórios, assegurando alinhamento com o referencial técnico da Companhia e as melhores práticas. Apoiar equipes de ativos na integração de CCS nas avaliações de subsuperfície e estudos de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para posicionamentos técnicos alinhados com parceiros (ex.: Petrobras) em temas relacionados a CCS; Identificar, propor e desenvolver colaborações e projetos de P&D com universidades, laboratórios, institutos de pesquisa e fornecedores, garantindo forte alinhamento com as prioridades estratégicas da TotalEnergies. Inclui prospecção e maturação de conceitos inovadores voltados aos desafios futuros do negócio, com foco na implementação de pilotos estratégicos; Justificar e apoiar a submissão de novas propostas de projetos, além de avaliar anualmente os projetos em andamento quanto à continuidade de financiamento, com base no conteúdo técnico, qualidade das entregas e alinhamento com os objetivos de P&D. Contribuir para a preparação orçamentária e para o desenvolvimento de dossiês de financiamento (ex.: EMBRAPII); Gerenciar a execução de projetos operados, assegurando entregas no prazo, dentro dos orçamentos aprovados e com comunicação eficaz dos resultados aos stakeholders relevantes. Produzir relatórios de P&D de alta qualidade, incluindo sumários de reuniões, sínteses de conferências, notas técnicas, propostas de trabalho e planos de execução de projetos; Manter colaboração proativa e construtiva com a Petrobras em todas as atividades relacionadas ao STCA, incluindo novas iniciativas, projetos de P&D e trocas de conhecimento; Monitorar o desenvolvimento tecnológico externo proveniente de concorrentes, fornecedores e academia, garantindo que a liderança de P&D da TotalEnergies esteja informada sobre sua relevância e impacto potencial. Acompanhar tecnologias emergentes de geociências aplicadas a CCS, avaliar sua aplicabilidade ao portfólio TEP-Brasil e promover sua avaliação e implementação por meio de projetos de P&D ou pilotos; Compartilhar conhecimento e desenvolver competências: contribuir para o desenvolvimento das capacidades em geociências para CCS na afiliada. Apoiar treinamentos, disseminação de conhecimento e melhores práticas, além de facilitar a comunicação entre P&D, ativos e comunidades técnicas; Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TTE e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo; Garantir a execução dos projetos conforme validado pela Diretoria de P&D e pelas principais partes interessadas; Assegurar a conformidade dos projetos com a regulamentação de P&D da ANP. Formação: Doutorado (preferencial) ou Mestrado em Geologia, Geofísica ou em área correlata de Geociências. Experiência profissional: Experiência em P&D em E&P e/ou Gestão de Projetos, com foco em atividades de Geociências. Considerando que a posição abrange Geofísica, Geologia e Reservatórios, é essencial experiência prévia em equipes de Geociências de Exploração ou de Ativos, bem como em temas relacionados à transição energética, como CCS. Capacidade analítica comprovada, aliada a excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de comunicação (oral e escrita), organização e apresentação. Alinhamento com os valores da Companhia. #J-18808-Ljbffr
